author: evolve
description: Public-repo feedback PM for a maintainer bot. Hourly sweep of a public GitHub repo's issues and PRs: classifies and labels each new item, keeps a public-to-private crosswalk ledger, drafts replies and private-tracker filings, and sends every draft to the operator for approval before anything is posted. Labels are the only automatic public action.
objective: Make a public repo feel staffed without giving an LLM write access to code: triage inbound issues/PRs, bridge real feedback into the maintainer's private tracker, and keep every public-facing word operator-approved (draft-first autonomy, PAT-scope trust boundary).
name: PM Inbox

files.reason: Holds the public (and optional private) GitHub PATs the hourly sweep authenticates with; the app fails closed without it (PM_INBOX_FAILED every window).

messaging_channel.reason: Delivers draft approvals (replies, closes, private filings) to the operator's primary channel via `openclaw message send`.

purposes: classify inbound public issues/PRs (bug/feature/question/support/spam-dupe + duplicate detection)
draft public replies (ack, repro request, docs-grounded answers, PR-concierge responses)
draft private-tracker issue titles/bodies for triaged non-trivial items

data_files.description: Public-to-private crosswalk ledger — one entry per public issue/PR with classification, labels applied, triage state, the private twin (once filed), contributor credit, and release-closeout state. Single source of truth for 'what public feedback exists and where it went'.

fields.entries: list of {public{repo,number,kind,url,title,author,opened_at}, classification, labels_applied[], state, duplicate_of, private{repo,number,url}|null, contributor{login,credit}, first_response_at, release_closed_in, notes}

data_files.description: Sweep watermark (`since`), rate-limit backoff, cached token identity.

Drafts awaiting operator approval (public comments and private filings). Approved -> drafts/sent/, declined -> drafts/dismissed/. Nothing public-facing posts without leaving this directory via an approval verb.

fields.title: issue title (private_issue only)
fields.context: one-line why, shown to the operator

identity.purpose: Act as the project manager for a public repo's feedback loop: triage inbound issues/PRs, keep the public-to-private crosswalk, and draft every public-facing response for operator approval — with the trust boundary enforced by GitHub PAT scopes, not prompts.
scope_includes: Hourly sweep of the public repo's issues and PRs (updated-since watermark)
Classify each new item (bug/feature/question/support/spam-dupe) and auto-apply the matching label
Detect duplicates against the crosswalk and draft 'duplicate of #N' replies
Draft first responses: acks, repro-info requests, docs-grounded answers, PR-concierge replies
Maintain pm_inbox/crosswalk.json (public#N <-> private#M, contributor credit, triage state)
Draft well-formed private-tracker issues (provenance link, aspect-hint labels, Proof: line when falsifiable)
Deliver draft summaries to the operator and execute approved drafts via post/file verbs
scope_excludes: Writing, merging, or reverting code anywhere (no contents write scope exists)
Running or triggering the public publish/release flow
Closing public issues (release-closeout belongs to a separate app)
Deleting anything (issues, comments, labels definitions, files)
Watching the private repo's PRs, CI, or dev flow (issue tracker only)
Auto-posting substantive public comments at the default autonomy rung
identity.bot_interaction_pattern: The hourly script does the sweeping and drafting; the bot's LLM is involved twice: (1) the sweep runs one headless `openclaw agent` turn to classify + draft (inheriting the bot's LLM stack), and (2) the operator approves/edits/dismisses drafts conversationally and the bot executes the matching pm_inbox.py verb per its AGENTS.md guidance block. The bot never touches GitHub except through the app's CLI verbs.
identity.user: The pod operator / repo maintainer — receives draft summaries and approves public-facing actions.

observable_outcomes: A new public issue is labeled and has a crosswalk entry within one sweep interval (1h) of being opened
Every public comment posted by the bot corresponds to a draft file in pm_inbox/drafts/sent/ (nothing posts without the approval trail)
A filed private issue carries the from-public label and a 'Public: <url>' provenance line the intake tooling can parse
PM_INBOX_RAN: emitted every hour; drafts summary message arrives only when there are drafts (no empty-noise messages)
External PR authors get a concierge reply explaining the snapshot-repo contribution model, and accepted patches get contributor.credit=true in the crosswalk
failure_signals: PM_INBOX_FAILED: tokens-missing-or-insecure — tokens file absent or not 0600
PM_INBOX_FAILED: auth — a PAT expired or was revoked
PM_INBOX_PARTIAL: llm-fallback — classification ran on keyword heuristics; drafts need operator origination
PM_INBOX_PARTIAL: rate-limited — GitHub API backoff engaged
No PM_INBOX_RAN: for >2 hours — scheduler unit not firing
A public comment exists with no matching drafts/sent/ record — the approval boundary was bypassed; treat as an incident

quality_bar.minimum: New public items are labeled and crosswalked hourly, and the operator sees a draft for everything that needs a response.
quality_bar.excellent: Reporters get kind, specific, correct responses within a day; the private tracker receives well-formed, deduplicated, provenance-linked issues the maintainer can dispatch without rework; contributors get credited at release.

build_spec:
# PM Inbox — Build Specification (V1)

## Overview

Build an hourly public-repo feedback PM for a maintainer bot. The app sweeps a
public GitHub repo's issues + PRs, classifies each new item, auto-applies the
matching label (the ONLY automatic public action at the default autonomy rung),
maintains a public-to-private crosswalk ledger, and turns everything else —
public replies, closes, and private issue filings — into DRAFTS delivered to
the operator over the bot's primary channel for approval. The operator approves
drafts conversationally; the bot executes the approved action via this app's CLI.

This is a scheduled script (not a persistent daemon): the scheduler fires it
hourly; it sweeps, drafts, delivers, and exits. It must run unchanged on macOS
and Linux pods (the target deployment is a Linux/systemd pod — never hardcode
`/Users/...`; resolve the home dir via `pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir`).

Trust frame (load-bearing — restate in scripts' docstrings): the app NEVER
writes or merges code, never runs a publish, never deletes. GitHub access is
via fine-grained PATs whose scopes enforce this below the LLM: the public repo
token has Issues RW + Pull requests/Contents read-only; the private repo token
has Issues RW only (no Contents). The app must degrade loudly, never widen scope.

---

## File Layout

```
scripts/
  pm_inbox.py            <- main CLI: sweep | drafts | post | file | dismiss | status
  pm-inbox-cron.sh       <- hourly trigger (calls pm_inbox.py sweep)
pm_inbox/
  config.json            <- operator config (seeded at install from template vars)
  crosswalk.json         <- public<->private ledger (schema below)
  state.json             <- sweep watermark + backoff state
  drafts/pending/        <- awaiting operator approval
  drafts/sent/           <- posted/filed (audit trail)
  drafts/dismissed/      <- operator declined
  runs/                  <- per-sweep result files: YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.json
```

All paths relative to the bot's workspace root (`~/.openclaw/workspace/`).

---

## config.json (seeded at install; created with defaults if absent)

```json
{
  "public_repo": "{public_repo}",
  "private_repo": "{private_repo}",
  "tokens_path": "~/.openclaw/pm-inbox-github-tokens.json",
  "autonomy_level": "R0",
  "aspects": [],
  "labels": {
    "bug": "bug", "feature": "feature", "question": "question",
    "support": "support", "spam-dupe": "spam", "duplicate": "duplicate"
  },
  "from_public_label": "from-public",
  "max_items_per_sweep": 30
}
```

- `public_repo` (required) — `owner/repo` the app triages.
- `private_repo` (optional, may be "") — `owner/repo` where triaged non-trivial
  items are filed. When empty, the `file` verb and private-filing drafts are
  disabled; everything else still works.
- `autonomy_level` — `R0` (default) | `R1` | `R2`. See "Autonomy gating" below.
- `aspects` — the operator's aspect-hint vocabulary for private filings
  (e.g. `["apps", "deploy", "ui"]`). The classifier may ONLY emit an aspect
  from this list; empty list means no aspect-prefixed labels are ever minted.

## Tokens file (never in the workspace, never logged)

`tokens_path` (default `~/.openclaw/pm-inbox-github-tokens.json`, bot-owned,
mode 0600) holds `{"public": "github_pat_...", "private": "github_pat_..."}`.
`private` may be absent when `private_repo` is "". On missing/unreadable file
or mode-not-0600: emit `PM_INBOX_FAILED: tokens-missing-or-insecure` and exit 1
(refuse to run with a world-readable token). Never echo token values anywhere.

---

## GitHub REST client (stdlib urllib only — no gh, no pip packages)

Base `https://api.github.com`; headers on every request:
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Accept: application/vnd.github+json`,
`X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`, `User-Agent: evolve-pm-inbox`.

Endpoints used (public token unless noted):

- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?state=all&sort=updated&direction=desc&since=<watermark>&per_page=100`
  — NOTE: this endpoint returns PRs too (a PR is an issue with a
  `pull_request` key); that is exactly what the sweep wants. Follow `Link`
  pagination, capped by `max_items_per_sweep`.
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}/labels` `{"labels": [...]}` — auto-label.
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments` — ONLY from the `post` verb
  (approved draft) or R1+ template ack. Works for PR conversations too.
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues` (private token, private repo) — ONLY from
  the `file` verb (approved draft) or R1+ auto-file.
- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}` (private token) — refresh crosswalked
  private issue state (closed => fixed) for entries with a private twin.

On 403 with `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`: write the reset time into
`state.json.backoff_until`, emit `PM_INBOX_PARTIAL: rate-limited`, finish what
needs no API, exit 0 (the next hourly run resumes). On 401: emit
`PM_INBOX_FAILED: auth` and exit 1. Timeouts 30s; one retry on 5xx.

---

## Sweep algorithm (`pm_inbox.py sweep`)

1. Load config + tokens + state (`state.json.since` watermark, ISO-8601;
   first run: now minus 7 days). Honor `backoff_until`.
2. Fetch updated issues/PRs since the watermark. Skip items authored by the
   bot's own token identity (`GET /user` once, cached in state.json).
3. For each item with no crosswalk entry: classify (below), apply the label
   for its class (plus `duplicate` when a duplicate), append a crosswalk entry
   (`state: "swept"`), and create drafts per the autonomy gating table.
4. For existing crosswalk entries that changed: record state transitions only
   (e.g. public issue closed by reporter -> `state: "dismissed"` if we never
   responded); refresh private-twin state for entries with `private` set
   (closed private twin = fix pending release — kept for the release radar).
5. Deliver: if any drafts were created (or a sweep failure needs eyes), send
   ONE summary message to the operator (delivery section below) listing each
   draft id, target, one-line context, and the proposed text (truncate each
   draft body to 400 chars in the message; the full text lives in the draft
   file and the operator can ask the bot to read it out).
6. Advance the watermark to the newest `updated_at` seen; write the run result
   file; emit `PM_INBOX_RAN: <counts>`.

Crosswalk writes are atomic (write `crosswalk.json.tmp` in the same dir, then
`os.replace`). Same for state.json and every draft file.

### Classification — one headless agent turn (inherits the bot's LLM)

Run ONE `openclaw agent` turn per sweep batching all new items (never one per
item): `openclaw agent --agent main --message=<prompt> --json` (the `--agent`
target is REQUIRED — current OC errors `No target session selected` without
it). `--json` wraps the reply in OC's envelope: parse stdout as JSON and read
the model text from `result.meta.finalAssistantVisibleText` (fallback
`finalAssistantRawText`), THEN extract the JSON array from that text with cwd = the bot's own
home. The prompt carries, per item: number, kind (issue|pr), title, body
(truncated 1500 chars), author, and the crosswalk's open-item titles for dedup
context, plus the `aspects` list. Output contract (the prompt must demand
EXACTLY this, no prose, no fences):

```json
[{"number": 12,
  "classification": "bug|feature|question|support|spam-dupe",
  "duplicate_of": null,
  "aspect": null,
  "agent_able": false,
  "proof": null,
  "reply_draft": "...",
  "private_title": null,
  "private_body": null}]
```

- `aspect` must be from config `aspects` or null (drop anything else).
- `proof` — a falsifiable acceptance test, ONLY when the report contains
  enough to state one; never invented. `agent_able` true requires `proof`.
- `reply_draft` — the proposed public reply (ack / repro request / docs-grounded
  answer for question-class / PR-concierge text for PRs). Kind by default:
  thank the reporter by name, plain language, no internal jargon.
- `private_title`/`private_body` — only for non-trivial bug/feature items:
  title `[public#N] <restatement>`; body MUST begin with a provenance line
  `Public: https://github.com/<public_repo>/issues/<N>` followed by reporter
  handle + classification, then the substance; include a `Proof: <test>` line
  when `proof` is set. (This exact shape is what the maintainer's intake
  tooling parses — the `Public:` link line, the `Proof:` line, and the labels
  below are load-bearing, not style.)

Parse failure or non-zero exit -> heuristic fallback: classify only
(keywords: title starting "how"/"?"-heavy -> question; "error"/"crash"/
"fail"/"broken"/traceback -> bug; "feature"/"request"/"would be nice" ->
feature; else support; near-identical title to an open crosswalk entry ->
spam-dupe/duplicate). Fallback creates NO reply or filing drafts — it labels,
records the crosswalk entry with `"needs_operator": true`, and the summary
message tells the operator classification ran degraded
(`PM_INBOX_PARTIAL: llm-fallback`).

### External-PR concierge

For PR items the reply_draft follows the snapshot-repo contribution model: the
public repo is a per-release snapshot, PRs are not merged in place; thank the
contributor, ask for / link the corresponding issue, explain the patch is
re-applied to the development repo with attribution and ships in the next
release. Set `contributor.credit: true` on the crosswalk entry when the patch
is accepted for re-apply (operator approves the concierge draft that says so),
so release notes can credit them.

### Autonomy gating (enforced in code, not in the prompt)

| autonomy_level | automatic | drafted for approval |
|---|---|---|
| R0 | labels only | every public comment; every private filing |
| R1 | + fixed-template ack comment; + private filings | substantive comments |
| R2 | + docs-grounded question answers (must cite a shipped doc) | anything off-template |

The sweep NEVER closes a public item at any rung. Closing at release time is a
separate app's job (release-closeout / release-radar), NOT pm-inbox — do not
build a close path into this app. Unknown `autonomy_level` -> treat as R0.

### Private filing (`file` verb or R1+ auto)

`POST /repos/<private_repo>/issues` with title/body from the draft and labels:
`from-public` always; `<aspect>:from-public` when aspect set;
`<aspect>:agent-able` (or bare `agent-able` when no aspect) only when the body
carries a `Proof:` line. On success update the crosswalk entry: `private`
block + `state: "filed"`. Labels that don't exist on the repo are created
implicitly by the API when the token can — if the API refuses, retry the
create WITHOUT labels, keep the issue, and surface
`PM_INBOX_PARTIAL: labels-missing` so the operator adds label definitions.

---

## Crosswalk file (`pm_inbox/crosswalk.json`, schema_version 1)

```json
{"schema_version": 1, "updated_at": "...", "entries": [
  {"public": {"repo": "...", "number": 12, "kind": "issue", "url": "...",
               "title": "...", "author": "...", "opened_at": "..."},
   "classification": "bug",
   "labels_applied": ["bug"],
   "state": "swept",
   "duplicate_of": null,
   "private": null,
   "contributor": {"login": "...", "credit": false},
   "first_response_at": null,
   "release_closed_in": null,
   "notes": ""}]}
```

`state` in `swept | acked | filed | answered | duplicate | closed-at-release |
dismissed`. One entry per public item keyed by (repo, number); `post` sets
`first_response_at` on the first public comment; `file` fills `private`.

## Draft files (`pm_inbox/drafts/pending/<draft_id>.json`)

```json
{"draft_id": "d-YYYYMMDD-NNN", "created_at": "...",
 "kind": "public_comment|private_issue",
 "target": {"repo": "...", "number": 12},
 "title": null, "labels": [], "body": "...",
 "context": "one-line why"}
```

`draft_id` is date + zero-padded counter, unique across the three subdirs.

---

## Operator approval loop — CLI verbs

- `pm_inbox.py drafts` — list pending drafts (id, kind, target, context).
- `pm_inbox.py post --draft <id> [--body-file <path>]` — post a
  `public_comment` draft (optionally with operator-edited text), move it to
  `sent/`, update the crosswalk (`acked`/`answered`), emit `PM_INBOX_POSTED: <id>`.
- `pm_inbox.py file --draft <id> [--body-file <path>]` — create the private
  issue from a `private_issue` draft, move to `sent/`, crosswalk -> `filed`,
  emit `PM_INBOX_FILED: <id>`.
- `pm_inbox.py dismiss --draft <id> --reason <text>` — move to `dismissed/`.
- `pm_inbox.py status` — watermark age, pending-draft count, oldest pending,
  rate-limit state.

All verbs are idempotent: a draft id not in `pending/` is a no-op with a clear
message (guards double-approval).

## AGENTS.md guidance for the bot

Add this block to the bot's AGENTS.md:

```
## PM Inbox

Hourly, a script sweeps the public repo and sends you draft replies/filings
for the operator to approve. When the operator says:
- "approve <draft-id>" -> run: python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py post --draft <id>
  (or `file --draft <id>` if the draft's kind is private_issue — check with
  `drafts` first if unsure). Report the command's outcome verbatim.
- "edit <draft-id>: <new text>" -> write the new text to a temp file and run
  the same verb with --body-file <temp>.
- "dismiss <draft-id> [reason]" -> python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py dismiss ...
- "pm status" / "any drafts?" -> python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py status / drafts.
NEVER post to GitHub except through these verbs. NEVER run the sweep's private
filing without an approved draft (the script enforces this too).
```

---

## Delivery

Use the canonical delivery pattern (docs/spec-gallery-delivery-convention-2026-06-11.md;
reference implementation docs/reference/capabilities/template/scripts/example_script.py):
resolve (channel, target) from the pod network.json — at the canonical shared
path for the platform: `/var/lib/evolve/network.json` on Linux,
`/Users/Shared/evolve/network.json` on macOS (try both, first readable wins) —
reading `bots.<bot_id>.primary_user.external_ids` (channel priority: telegram,
whatsapp, signal, imessage, slack, discord, sms, matrix — intersected with the
bot's own enabled channels from its openclaw.json `channels.<name>.enabled`,
falling back to the best recorded id when there is no overlap so the send
fails loudly), then run `openclaw message send --channel=<ch> --target=<target>
--message=<text> --json` as the bot user (binary: `shutil.which("openclaw")`,
falling back to /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin; cwd = the
executing account's pwd-database home, NOT $HOME; child PATH prefixed with the
CLI's own bin dir; timeout 60s). Exit 0 = channel accepted. Never read gateway
port/token; never POST to the gateway.

Send-outcome honesty: a sweep with zero drafts and zero failures sends NOTHING
(no noise) and still writes its run file. A sweep that created drafts writes the
run file ONLY after the summary message send succeeds; on send failure emit
`PM_INBOX_FAILED: delivery-error` and exit 1 without the run file. No route
configured -> log `DELIVERY_SKIPPED:` and exit 0 without the run file.

NOTE — deliberate divergence from the delivery convention: the convention
(docs/spec-gallery-delivery-convention-2026-06-11.md §"Send-outcome semantics")
treats a run file's existence as the claim "the user got a delivery". pm-inbox
is NOT a user-facing scheduled-delivery app — most sweeps have nothing to say,
and forcing a message every hour would be pure noise. So here the run file is
RAN-evidence (the sweep executed), and a delivery claim ONLY when drafts were
created (those runs gate the run file on send success). Because of this, do NOT
declare `run_file` as delivery evidence in this app's instance manifest — the
delivery monitor would otherwise read a quiet-hour run file as a delivered
window and mask a broken channel. Declare `delivery_contract: null`; the sweep
signals (`PM_INBOX_RAN:`) are the health evidence, not delivery windows.

## Run result file (`pm_inbox/runs/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.json`)

```json
{"ran_at": "...", "since": "...", "items_seen": 4, "new": 2,
 "labeled": 2, "drafts_created": 3, "drafts_pending_total": 3,
 "llm_mode": "agent|fallback", "partial": [], "message_sent": true}
```

---

## Signals

`PM_INBOX_RAN:` `PM_INBOX_IDLE:` (backoff window) `PM_INBOX_PARTIAL: <reason>`
`PM_INBOX_FAILED: <reason>` `PM_INBOX_POSTED:` `PM_INBOX_FILED:`
`DELIVERY_SKIPPED:`

---

## Scheduling

One hourly scheduled action (see the manifest's `scheduled_actions[]`; label
`ai.evolve.${bot_id}.pm-inbox`). Emit the structured entry and nothing else —
do NOT write plist or unit files from the build; the structured entry is the
single source of truth and the forge materializer wires the platform's unit.

Deployment reality: the forge app-cron materializer is currently launchd/macOS
only (it hardcodes /Users paths and raises off macOS). On a Linux pod the
hourly trigger will NOT be wired until the platform's Linux systemd materializer
for gallery scheduled_actions lands. Until then the app is fully usable via
manual `pm_inbox.py sweep` and the operator-approval verbs — only the automatic
hourly fire is pending. Do not compensate by hand-writing a systemd unit from
this build; that is the materializer's job, not the app's.

---

## Rendered files

## FILE: scripts/pm-inbox-cron.sh
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# pm-inbox-cron.sh -- PM Inbox hourly trigger (installed by the PM Inbox app).
# Portable: resolves the workspace from this script's own location so the same
# file works under /home/<bot> (Linux) and /Users/<bot> (macOS).
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
LOGFILE="/tmp/$(id -un)-pm-inbox.log"

python3 "$SCRIPT_DIR/pm_inbox.py" sweep >> "$LOGFILE" 2>&1
```

---

## Template variables

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{public_repo}` | yes | — | owner/repo of the public repo to triage |
| `{private_repo}` | no | "" | owner/repo of the private tracker for filings ("" disables filing) |

---

## Test sequence

After building (all steps must exit 0):

```bash
# 1. Syntax check
python3 -m py_compile scripts/pm_inbox.py

# 2. Status before any run
python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py status
# Expected: no watermark yet, 0 pending drafts

# 3. Tokens guard: with tokens file absent, sweep must refuse
python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py sweep; test $? -ne 0
# Expected: PM_INBOX_FAILED: tokens-missing-or-insecure

# 4. Mode guard: create a 0644 tokens file, sweep must refuse
#    (then chmod 600 and confirm it proceeds to the API phase)

# 5. Draft verbs are idempotent
python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py post --draft d-00000000-000
# Expected: clear 'no such pending draft' message, exit 0

# 6. Executable check
test -x scripts/pm-inbox-cron.sh && echo 'OK: cron script executable'
```
example_triggers: edit d-20260702-002: thanks — can you share the exact error output?
what public issues came in this week?

test_cases.expected: Run python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py post --draft d-20260702-001 (or file, per the draft's kind), report the outcome, confirm the draft moved to drafts/sent/
Run python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py drafts and relay the pending list (id, target, one-line context each)
Run python3 scripts/pm_inbox.py status and relay watermark age, pending-draft count, and rate-limit state

safety: Trust boundary is the PAT scopes: public repo issues RW + PRs/contents read-only; private tracker issues RW ONLY (no contents) — never widen scopes to work around an error
Labels are the only automatic public action at the default rung; every comment/close/filing is draft-first
Tokens live in a bot-owned 0600 file outside the workspace; never in config.json, logs, run files, or messages
No code writes, no merges, no publish, no deletes — at every autonomy rung
LLM access inherits the bot's stack via headless openclaw agent turns — no per-app credentials, no direct provider API calls
dependencies: messaging_channel (required) — draft summaries and approvals ride the operator conversation
pm_inbox_github_pats (required) — two fine-grained PATs (one per resource owner), stored 0600
boundaries: One crosswalk entry per public item; drafts reference entries, never duplicate them
The sweep never closes public items; closeout is a separate app's job
Private-repo surface is the issue tracker only — no PR/CI/dev-flow watching
Empty sweeps send no operator message (run files are the ran-evidence)

scheduled_actions.summary: Hourly public-repo sweep: classify, label, crosswalk, draft, deliver.

trigger_recognition.pattern: The hourly sweep runs itself. The bot acts when the operator responds to a draft summary (approve/edit/dismiss <draft-id>) or asks about the public inbox (status, pending drafts, what came in). All GitHub actions go through scripts/pm_inbox.py verbs.

usage.how_to_use: Don't trigger the sweep manually except to verify an install. When the operator approves a draft, run the matching pm_inbox.py verb (post for public_comment, file for private_issue) and report the command outcome verbatim. When they edit, pass the new text via --body-file. Never post to GitHub any other way.
bot_voice_examples: 3 new items this sweep — labeled 2 bugs and a question; 3 drafts pending: d-20260702-001 (reply to #12, repro request), d-20260702-002 (private filing for #12), d-20260702-003 (PR concierge for #14).
Posted the reply to #12 and moved d-20260702-001 to sent — first response logged.
Filed the tracker issue for #12 (private #3401) with from-public labels; crosswalk updated.
